Hi Alexa/Vanessa/Jordan,

Thanks for the update and the revised copy. A few compliance and publish notes from the marketplace intake team:

- Avoid absolute latency claims unless backed by AWS-approved benchmarks. "Predictable low-latency" is fine.
- Product images: hero must include a 1920x600 PNG and feature thumbnails at 64x64. Provide alt text for accessibility.
- Billing: for co-sell offers we require a clear pricing model in the offer details and a billing contact who will handle transacting via seller central.
- APN/co-sell badge: to enable co-sell, Redwood must complete the APN partner self-identification and provide an approved joint pitch deck.

Action items for Redwood/Acme:
1) Submit updated product page assets (copy + images) by Nov 30 to the marketplace console link below.
2) Upload the compliance one-pager and your encryption / data residency statement.
3) Confirm billing contact and provide a signed logo usage agreement for customer logos.

AWS intake console: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/console-link

If you miss Nov 30, the next intake window is mid-December. Happy to accept a late draft but co-sell enablement will be bumped.

Regards,
Samir Patel
AWS Marketplace Intake
